issue.body:
Implement the Italian Fiscal Code algorithm in **Kotlin** and get it verified by the shared test suite.

### What to build

A program that reads one JSON object on stdin and writes the fiscal code (or an error) as JSON on stdout, exactly as described in [SPECIFICATION.md](https://github.com/openapi/every-language-fiscal-code/blob/main/SPECIFICATION.md).

```console
$ echo '{"surname":"ROSSI","name":"MARIO","birth_date":"1980-01-01","sex":"M","birthplace_code":"H501"}' | ./elc run kotlin
{"fiscal_code": "RSSMRA80A01H501U"}
```

### Suggested setup

| | |
|---|---|
| Directory | `languages/kotlin/` |
| Family | `jvm` |
| Docker base | `eclipse-temurin:21-jdk + kotlinc` (just a suggestion) |

### Checklist

- [ ] `languages/kotlin/` with source, `Dockerfile`, `run.sh`, `manifest.yaml` and `README.md`
- [ ] The algorithm is written entirely in Kotlin (no wrappers, no fiscal-code libraries, no remote calls)
- [ ] `./elc test kotlin` passes **87/87**
- [ ] PR opened with `Closes #<this issue>`

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/openapi/every-language-fiscal-code/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [Python](https://github.com/openapi/every-language-fiscal-code/tree/main/languages/python) / [PHP](https://github.com/openapi/every-language-fiscal-code/tree/main/languages/php) implementations for complete examples.

🎃 This issue is part of **Hacktoberfest**. Comment below to claim it!

comment.body:
Hi @francescobianco, I've finished the Kotlin implementation and opened PR #22 with `Closes #6`.

- 100% native Kotlin with self-contained JSON parser (zero external dependencies)
- Multi-stage Docker build on Temurin 21 Alpine
- 87/87 test vectors passed

Thank you for assigning this to me! 🙌
